Evidence comes only from the supplied point, seed and pinned source text. Binding detail follows diagramSource.ts; mapping identity and ordering follow codePanel.ts; access boundaries follow corpus.ts and projectSource.ts; lookup and lifetime detail follow projectLanguageService.ts; UI detail follows RepositoryFileExplorer.tsx and SourceCodeView.tsx. The seed's destination-selection description is narrowed: SourceCodeView selects only the first line of a multi-line destination, and restoration/activation guards affect when navigation runs. UTF-16 initialization accepts an omitted server encoding but rejects a different declared encoding. Session sharing is explicitly scoped to a service instance and canonical root.
